title: Needed One Myself
text: Needed One Myself. This is my second purchase of this item. Originally I purchased for my sister. She loves it and uses it daily. unfortunately I broke my original mug and asked her how she like it. After her review I decided to replace my broken one. I got this at a fantastic price. ($11.99) I love using it. I have a ton of mint in my backyard, chocolate, orange, peppermint as well as spearmint . I have been mixing the leaves and making mint tea. The only problem that I have is I got a small cut to my finger washing the steel insert. Maybe I was washing to hard. But be careful if you are handwashing the steel (tin) part. Ordering a bottle brush. that will solve the problem. But I love this item.
